name: Caduceus for OM-3
description: Round film grain with fewer repeats (Medium and Coarse were built from little squares); a film's WB Compensation is now the camera's own, so the super control panel shows it (#88); a new film set gives the camera the film's white balance straight away. Camera-tested as the combined test build (fix #88 + grain g4) under its release name.
